newsitem.title: USA: Avenal, Calif., redeems $2 mln of revenue bonds.
newsitem.headline: Avenal, Calif., redeems $2 mln of revenue bonds.

text.p: The Avenal, Calif., Public Financing Authority said on Tuesday it redeemed $2 million of its $11 million issue of 1989 local agency revenue bonds.
The redemption price included a three percent premium, in accordance with the provisions of the trust indenture for the bonds, Avenal said in a statement.
Funds for the redemption came primarily from the authority's prior sale, at par plus accrued interest, of $1 million each of bonds issued by Nevada County, Calif., and the city of Ione.

The authority said it no longer owns any bonds of local agencies outside Avenal. The remaining $9 million of outstanding Avenal authority bonds are secured by a reserve fund and by bonds issued within the Avenal community.
Avenal said all debt service payments on the authority bonds have been made as scheduled.
The redeemed bonds included all $1 million principal of the authority's bonds maturing on Oct 1, 2020 and $1 million principal from the bonds maturing on Oct 1 2019.

The Avenal bonds were underwritten by First California Capital Markets Group Inc. The Securities and Exchange Commission has been investigating the bonds, First California as well as Avenal, Ione and Nevada County.
